description: This Kotlin source file defines the main activity for an Android application that incorporates user authentication and a simple calculator. The activity manages UI components, handles user interaction events, performs basic user authentication with in-memory storage, and executes arithmetic operations based on user input.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: Main activity class managing user login, registration, and calculator functionalities with UI binding and event wiring.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, binds UI components, wires events, seeds an example account, and shows the login view.

methods.name: bindViews
methods.description: Associates UI components from layout to class variables using findViewById.

methods.name: wireEvents
methods.description: Sets click listeners for various UI buttons to handle navigation, authentication, and calculation actions.

methods.name: showLogin
methods.description: Displays the login view and hides other containers.

methods.name: showSignUp
methods.description: Displays the sign-up view and hides other containers.

methods.name: showDashboard
methods.description: Displays the main dashboard with a welcome message after successful login or registration.

methods.name: clearAuthErrors
methods.description: Hides error messages related to authentication.

methods.name: setLoginError
methods.description: Displays an error message during login.

methods.name: setSignUpError
methods.description: Displays an error message during sign-up.

methods.name: attemptLogin
methods.description: Validates user credentials against in-memory accounts and navigates to dashboard on success.

methods.name: attemptSignUp
methods.description: Creates a new user account after validation and navigates to dashboard.

methods.name: clearCalculatorState
methods.description: Resets calculator input fields and result display.

methods.name: compute
methods.description: Performs arithmetic operation based on user input and updates the result display.

methods.name: showCalcError
methods.description: Displays an error message related to calculator input validation.

methods.name: parseDoubleOrNull
methods.description: Parses a string to Double, returns null if invalid.

methods.name: formatNumber
methods.description: Formats a Double number for display, removing unnecessary decimal points.

methods.name: isValidEmail
methods.description: Performs basic validation to check if an email string looks valid.
